title: United Airlines resolves system outage that affected departing flights
description: The airline said there was no impact on flights in progress and there was no indication the outage was a cyberattack.

title: Airlines Face Fuel Crisis as Price Hedges Expire
description: Reports about an oil glut are back in the media, and U.S. diesel just dropped below $6 per gallon. But these signs of normalization have yet to reach the airline industry, where jet fuel prices remain eye-wateringly high and hedging…
